page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.32xlarge is an enterprise-scale general-purpose server type designed to handle heavy parallelized computing tasks. Managed by the KVM hypervisor, this instance utilizes AMD EPYC 9T34 processors built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, delivering dedicated compute resources without multi-tenant vCPU contention.

The server is equipped with 512 GB of system RAM, providing an even allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU, characteristic of general-purpose sizing profiles. There is no bundled local NVMe storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be provisioned via remote block storage volumes. Networking capabilities include a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, which ensures high data throughput for inter-node communication and distributed traffic.

From a hardware efficiency perspective, the absence of local disks simplifies operational state management and migration but places higher dependence on network storage performance. Lacking discrete GPUs, this instance is not designed for direct machine learning model acceleration or graphical rendering. Instead, the substantial vCPU count, balanced memory pool, and 64 Gbps network pipe make the ecs.g8ae.32xlarge well fitted for distributed systems, container orchestration clusters, large relational databases, in-memory caches, and high-concurrency enterprise services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.32xlarge is a high-capacity, general-purpose cloud instance engineered for large-scale enterprise deployments requiring substantial compute and memory resources. Built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via KVM, the instance is powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz across 128 vCPUs. It features 512 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core. The instance provides 64 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to support high-throughput network operations. Dedicated local storage is not provided, requiring external network-attached block storage for persistent data requirements. With its balanced hardware distribution and high core count, the ecs.g8ae.32xlarge is suited for multi-tier web applications, distributed container environments, enterprise application servers, memory-intensive batch processing, and large backend databases requiring high parallel processing power.
